title: k-Positive Maps: New Characterizations and a Generation Method
parent_read_scope: Reader-rendered sections through Eq.(6) and the immediately following explanation, specifically rendered lines318–345; not the complete paper or later versions.
equation6: F(Phi) = min Tr(C(Phi tensor id_k) P), over P>=0 on (C^d tensor C^k) tensor (C^d tensor C^k), P^T_first>=0, Tr_first(P)=omega and Tr_second(P)=rho, with BOTH rho,omega arbitrary density operators.
normalization: Because either marginal is a density operator, Tr(P)=1. The marginal states are variables, not fixed shared values.
